source.map: Tualatin Comprehensive Plan Map 10-3, Central Tualatin Overlay Zone (flats/config/areas/or/clackamas/tualatin/central-tualatin-overlay-map-10-3.map-only.pdf, page 1 EXISTING); TDC 58.110 sends the reader to it, and 58.400(2) makes Block 1 the only sub-district of the CO zone in the overlay

inputs.zoning: the city zoning map's CO polygon (quadfit s1_zoning_zoning_tualatin, data/quadfit_2026-10-28_c4)

source.how: Map 10-3 colours Block 1 CO and draws it between Block 4, Block 2 and the overlay's north and east line. The only CO ground in the overlay is the north part of 2S124A003100, a lot the zoning map splits CO (453,566 sq ft) and CC (535,390 sq ft); the block line between Blocks 1 and 2 runs on that zone line. Block 1 is drawn as the lot clipped to the CO polygon, checked by laying the lot over Map 10-3 registered on the block labels (residuals 19-208 ft). CO ground of the same zoning polygon north of the lot belongs to no taxlot the screen holds and is not drawn.
